periods.warm_up: 2021/22 is training history only; scoring starts 1 Aug 2022.
periods.development: 1 Aug 2022 - 30 Jun 2025, Pinnacle pre-match prices. Build and choose candidates here.
periods.validation: 1 Jul 2025 - 15 Jan 2026, Pinnacle pre-match prices. Already inspected by earlier diagnostics; the cagey correction is out-of-sample here.
periods.holdout: 16 Jan 2026 - 8 Nov 2026, Bet365 pre-match prices with the margin removed. Pinnacle prices in the files stop on 15 Jan 2026. Locked until a candidate is declared.

release_rule: A candidate is scored on the holdout once, against a written declaration. It must beat its baseline with the 95% week-resampled interval clear of zero, and must beat the market reference by more than the measured Bet365-Pinnacle gap to count as beating the market. Changes reach production only through a reviewed PR after a short forward run in shadow.
